title: thoughtbot moves into a purpose trust, and its CEO explains the transaction
summary: Pytel took the software consultancy he has run for over twenty years into a purpose trust, structuring a deal that paid shareholders while putting the mission beyond its founders. He walks through the reasoning with Eric, alongside what AI is doing to consulting.
blockquote: They also discuss another big decision: moving thoughtbot into a purpose trust. Chad shares how the company structured a transaction that paid its shareholders while protecting its independence and mission beyond its founders.
blockquote_source: The Eric Ries Show, episode announcement

source_urls.label: Peter Koehler of Stronghold Ownership, who advised the transition
